description: Checkpoint for the Daily Code Review routine. Records the last commit on the default branch (main) that has been reviewed. The next run diffs main from this SHA forward. Update after each run.

lastRun.notes:
16 commits / 217 files (~10,539 insertions, ~1,907 deletions). One ticket filed: ADS-1408 (Improvement, Medium) — the gateway→UI chat adapter hardcodes every sender/participant display name to '' because the gateway chat shape carries only ids, so once chat became functional (ADS-870, 0bd3eff) every OTHER-party message renders nameless (client/rescue blank labels, admin 'Unknown User', empty aria-labels). User-visible across all three apps on a core journey; filed as a follow-up gap, not a defect in the commit's fix.

The 16 commits:
- f629772 (#1514) fix(observability): harden cAdvisor/node-exporter host mounts (ADS-1376) — Security routine territory; ADS-1376 Done.
- e74054c (#1530) docs: restore RPCs dropped from README contract tables — docs only.
- 30f60b7 (#1531) fix: pin qs/fast-copy in pact dev chain (ADS-1407) — deps; ADS-1407 Done (Security/DevEx).
- a5d20e3 (#1527) feat(chat): real per-conversation unread count — REVIEWED IN DEPTH (subagent). Single grouped aggregate (no N+1), COUNT rule parity with getChatUnreadCount (excludes own + soft-deleted, LEFT-JOIN-NULL for unread), proto optional uint32, clean types, tested at handler/adapter/e2e layers. NO defect cleared the bar.
- f8ca2c7 (#1526) feat(auth): scoped applicant lookup (GetApplicantProfile) — REVIEWED IN DEPTH (subagent), authorization-sensitive. Tenant scoping enforced IN the handler via requirePermission(APPLICATIONS_VIEW,{rescueId}) with defense-in-depth over the upstream applications.Get; applicant id taken from the application record not caller input; narrow PII projection; negative cross-tenant cases tested. NO IDOR, NO defect cleared the bar. (One Low — per-application fan-out — already acknowledged in code; skipped per signal-over-noise.)
- b4b354b (#1525) fix(lib.components): darken primary for WCAG AA contrast — a11y/token fix, scoped + tested. No finding.
- 0bd3eff (#1524) fix: make core user journeys work in browser + UI e2e (ADS-870) — REVIEWED IN DEPTH (subagent). Clean 'make it work' commit; contract mismatches fixed at the right layer, each with a behaviour test; e2e asserts corrected behaviour (not smoke). 4 Low findings; 3 skipped per signal-over-noise (duplicate-app guard >100-page edge = theoretical + acknowledged in-commit; listApplicationQuestions unscoped = deliberate, negligible reference-data disclosure; import-ordering = cosmetic, not lint-enforced). 1 filed: ADS-1408 (blank chat names).
- c909aa9 (#1522) fix(gateway): harden upload/invitation/cms routes (ADS-1379,1380,1366) — REVIEWED by hand (self). Zod strictObject bodies + caps, well-reasoned and tested. Security routine territory; all three tickets Done. No introduced regression.
- d6b6f96 (#1521) refactor(db): share seed production guard + lint pact tests (ADS-1383,1386) — REVIEWED by hand (self). Implements last run's ADS-1383 exactly: extracts assertNotProduction to seed-faker, imported by 5 seeders, behaviour unchanged, one shared test block. Clean. Both tickets Done.
- 49e9d79 (#1519) fix(gateway): harden security headers/secret compares/trust proxy (ADS-1377,1378,1365,1382) — REVIEWED by hand (self). constant-time.ts helper correct (byte-length guard before timingSafeEqual, no throw on mismatch, multibyte-safe) and thoroughly tested; trustProxy gating + CSP changes tested. Security routine territory; all Done. No introduced regression.
- 9d50d6a (#1518) docs: onboarding/commit-convention drift — docs only (DevEx, tickets Done).
- 8076c10 (#1517) docs: secret/env var requirements — docs only (DevEx, tickets Done).
- ed356c0 (#1516) docs(ci): stale CI docs + Renovate — docs/ci (DevEx, tickets Done).
- 03aec63 (#1520) ci: image smoke/secret guard/coverage cache — ci only (DevEx, tickets Done).
- 192dcd7 (#1523) fix(deps): patch sharp/dompurify/proxy-addr/otel advisories (ADS-1397) — deps (Security, ADS-1397 Done).

Method: the three feature commits (chat unread, auth applicant lookup, core journeys) carried no code-review ticket and introduced new behaviour, so each got a dedicated deep-review subagent against correctness/edge-cases/SQL/type-safety/test-coverage/authz. The hardening/refactor/deps/docs/ci commits all map 1:1 to existing Done Security/DevEx tickets (guardrails 3 & 5); reviewed the product-code hardening implementations by hand for introduced regressions — none found. Overlap check (guardrail 3): searched Linear across ALL labels; no existing ticket covers the chat display-name gap. ADS-1383 (last run's finding) was implemented by d6b6f96 and is Done.
